title: Ghostly Piano Lament
description: A pale woman wearing a dark patterned headscarf sits on a stone bench playing a grand piano in a surreal green landscape. Above her, a white ghostly wolf howls inside an ornate circular mandala filled with musical notes, flowers, and floating silhouettes of running wolves and dancing figures against a dark background.
prompt: A surreal dark green fantasy scene featuring a pale woman in a black patterned headscarf playing a grand piano on a stone bench.
